messages:
alex: Heads-up — PR #51234 is blocked by a macOS smoke snapshot mismatch in CI, looks like render/snapshot_diff_test is failing on shard macos-smoke.

maria: @alex can you paste the failing diff or test log? want to see whether it's a legit change or flaky.

alex: sure. excerpt from the job:
```
AssertionError: Snapshot mismatch
Expected: <image hash 3f4a>
Actual:   <image hash 7b2c>
Failed at: render/snapshot_diff_test::RenderSmoke
```
I haven't been able to repro locally on my MBP (same macOS), tried `yarn test render --shard=macos-smoke` and passed.

sam: CI shows identical diffs across two runs — might be non-deterministic or an infra artifact. @ci-bot can you show the env for the failing run?

ci-bot: env dump for job 51234-macos-smoke-7:
RENDER_ENGINE=metal
XCODE_VERSION=13.4.1
NODE_VERSION=18.12.0
GPU=intel-iris-550

toni: @alex did this PR change any fonts or asset pipeline? snapshots have been sensitive to font antialiasing before.

alex: no font changes. small refactor to the render compositor that *shouldn't* affect pixels, but possible timing change. I can try a small tolerance tweak on the snapshot.

lina: can we do a targeted rerun on the macos-smoke shard first? if it flakes we can consider updating the snapshot or doing a one-off skip.

sam: requesting targeted rerun now — command used: `./cictl rerun --pr=51234 --shard=macos-smoke --type=targeted`

ci-bot: rerun queued (targeted) for shard macos-smoke, attempt #2. link: https://ci.example.com/job/51234/2

alex: attempt #2 still failed, same diff. attaching small cropped diff in thread.

maria: since rerun also failed, I'm leaning toward a flaky/non-deterministic regression caused by timing. Options: (1) update snapshot after verifying visually, (2) add tolerance in test, (3) revert the change if risky.

toni: quick ask — can someone run a local instrumented run with `RENDER_DETERMINISTIC=1` and see if it passes? if deterministic build passes maybe it's infra.

alex: running now with `RENDER_DETERMINISTIC=1 yarn test render --shard=macos-smoke` — will post results in ~3m.

alex: update — deterministic run passed locally. so likely timing/infra. I can try adding a short sleep in compositor as an experiment, or we can accept a snapshot update after visual check.

lina: given this is blocking a merge and the change is minor, I'd prefer to update the snapshot after alex confirms visually that the new output is expected. @toni can you do eyes on the diff?

toni: will eyeball now :eyes:

toni: looked at the crop — differences are extremely minor (1-2 px anti-alias). ok to update snapshot. :thumbsup:

maria: rules — do a targeted approval and note in PR that snapshot updated non-behavioral. @alex bump the tests and push new snapshot commit, then request a final rerun.

alex: done — pushed snapshot update in PR branch, commit `snap-update: macos smoke`. requesting final targeted rerun.

ci-bot: rerun queued (targeted) for shard macos-smoke, attempt #3. link: https://ci.example.com/job/51234/3

ci-bot: attempt #3 passed on macos-smoke. full CI still running.

sam: great. folks, remember to call out visual check in PR description when updating snapshots. I'll keep an eye on the full job and merge once all green and a reviewer lgtm is present.

alex: thanks all — @toni thanks for the quick eyes. will mark PR ready for merge after final CI.

toni: no problem. :shipit:
